column4: After a long journey, you’ve arrived in Lumiose City! But a Pokémon named Pancham has run off with your bag... Chase after it to reclaim your belongings!
The city changes a lot when the sun goes down. Find your way out of this “battle zone” and retreat to the safety of Hotel Z with the help of your new friend .

column3: A New Life in Lumiose City
column4: It’s been one unexpected development after another, but your new life in Lumiose is off to an exciting start. Have your new friend show you the ropes.
To take part in a promotion match, you must first take on other Trainers in the battle zone and earn yourself a ticket. Clear this initial hurdle, then reach Rank Y!

column3: The City in the Shadow of Prism Tower
column4: is here to show you more facets of Lumiose City. What kinds of experiences await you in this lively metropolis?
Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: an office worker named Yvon. Earn points and get yourself a ticket so you can aim for Rank X!
Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: a grade-schooler named Xavi. Earn points and get yourself a ticket so you can aim for Rank W!
Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: a waiter named Rintaro. Earn points and get yourself a ticket so you can aim for Rank V!
A mysterious Pokémon appeared before you, and it seems to want you to follow it...
Mega Rings, Mega Stones, and bonds with your Pokémon... It seems there is much for you to learn before you’ll truly understand Mega Evolution.
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Slowbro in the Bleu District. Use your new Mega Ring and face this Slowbro in battle!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Camerupt in the Jaune District. Use your new Mega Ring and face this Camerupt in battle!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Victreebel in the Magenta District. Use your new Mega Ring and face this Victreebel in battle!
Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: the wildly popular streamer Canari. You’ll have to track her down and defeat her to move up a rank!
Vinnie has alerted you to three more cases of Rogue Mega Evolution. Take care of them all to keep Lumiose City safe!
Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: Ivor, the leader of the Fist of Justice. Get yourself a Challenger’s Ticket to take him on!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Beedrill in the Vert District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Hawlucha in the Magenta District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Banette in the Jaune District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!

column3: A Request from the Rust Syndicate
column4: It’s come to light that has gotten deep into debt with the Rust Syndicate. Team MZ needs to fix this disaster—the sooner, the better!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Mawile in the Magenta District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Barbaracle in the Bleu District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around an Ampharos in the Rouge District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: Corbeau, the boss of the Rust Syndicate. Get a Challenger’s Ticket, then take him on to move up a rank!

column3: A Showdown on the Battle Court
column4: With the crisis over ’s debt settled, you and the rest of the team finally have a quiet moment. Why not take a break and enjoy a Pokémon battle on a real battle court!
You’ve received an invitation from Jacinthe, the head of the Lumiose Society of Battle Connoisseurs, otherwise known as the SBC. What in the world might await you there?
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Froslass in the Bleu District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around an Altaria in the Magenta District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Venusaur in the Jaune District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: the SBC’s own Jacinthe. Get a Challenger’s Ticket, then take her on to move up a rank!
It appears that Vinnie has something important he needs to talk to you about...
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Dragonite in the Vert District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Tyranitar in the Jaune District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Starmie in the Bleu District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted!
Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided, and it’s...someone called Grisham? The photo doesn’t tell you much—finding them is going to be tough!
Throw aside past rivalries and work together to save the city and your friends! You know your destination—now go find Zygarde where it waits for you!
Things are beginning to return to normal in Lumiose after the trouble at the tower. What will you and decide to do with the wishes you earned by reaching Rank A?
The curtains have drawn back on the Infinite Z-A Royale! Collect Challenger’s Tickets so you can take part in reward matches for the fabulous prizes they offer!
Work together with Mable, who was once a member of Team Flare, to protect Lumiose City from the threat of “the one that gives.”
Work together with Grisham and Vinnie to protect Lumiose City from the threat of “the one that takes.”

column3: To Keep the World in Balance
column4: What is it that people and Pokémon ought to do to preserve the world’s beauty? What does Zygarde think? What do you believe?

column3: A Use for an Evolution Stone!
column4: A Trainer wants a Pikachu she can use a Thunder Stone on. She’s offered to trade you her Heracross in exchange.
The requester says he saw a giant Bunnelby in an alleyway outside of the wild zones. Meet the requester at the location.
The requester dropped something precious in the cemetery, which has now become a wild zone. Your job is to retrieve the item.
Distan seems to think that attacking from a distance with long-range moves is the most stylish strategy. Take him on in a Pokémon battle to see if he’s right.
The requester says Fairy-type Pokémon are her favorites. Take her on in battle using your own favorite Pokémon.

column3: I’d Like to See an Ekans!
column4: A young girl wants to see the Snake Pokémon Ekans up close. Catch an Ekans and show it to her.
A young girl is training hard to become the strongest Kakuna user. Let her show off her Kakuna in battle.
You’ve been roped into chaperoning a grumpy Slurpuff. Take it to Café Soleil and hang out there until Slurpuff is satisfied.
The requester says she is worried about her Audino, which is behaving strangely. Maybe a Pokémon battle will calm Audino down...
Paralysis will slow your Pokémon down, while poison will gradually drain their HP. Which is stronger? Find out for yourself!
An old gentleman has invited you to join what seems to be an event showcasing Budew. Bring a Budew with you to participate.
The requester says she wants to make perfume using Skiddo leaves. What kind of aroma will this perfume have?
The requester says she now wants to make perfume using snow from Vanillite. What aroma will the perfume have this time?
The requester has asked for an Abra to play tag with. He’s offered to trade you his Riolu in exchange.
The requester has recently started a courier business. He says he needs an extra-large Gogoat in order to haul bigger loads. See if you can find one for him.
The requester says he needs Pansage, Pansear, and Panpour to create the perfect cup of tea. Find all three Pokémon and bring them to the requester.

column3: Just a Few Questions for You...
column4: You ran into a Goomy out and about at night. After a moment, someone called out—a police officer. Seems she’s got some questions for you...
Galarian Slowpoke apparently look different compared to Slowpoke from other regions. Trade your own Slowpoke for the requester’s Galarian Slowpoke.
Status moves can power up your Pokémon or hinder the opponent. Two Trainers who are skilled in using both kinds of status moves have challenged you to a battle.
Some Pokémon don’t evolve unless you become very close with them. Battle the Pokémon that the requester has raised with tender loving care!

column3: Moves That Put Up a Wall
column4: There are moves that reduce damage to your Pokémon by creating barriers around them. The requester wants to battle you to show off strategies centered on these moves.
Litleo’s fire is absolutely essential for this restaurant’s delicious food. Help Litleo get fired up for cooking with a battle.
An alpha Weedle is ruining the requester’s garden by gnawing on all the plants. It keeps coming back even if it gets chased away, so try catching it with a Poké Ball instead.
The requester is very proud of the massive Magikarp he caught. Find a Magikarp even larger than one with a size classification of XL to show him there’s always a bigger fish!
Some Rust Syndicate grunts are arguing about whose Pokémon is the strongest. Help them come to a conclusion.
Wild Trubbish are gathering at Café Pokémon-Amie, causing the business to lose customers! Save the café by taking the Trubbish somewhere else.
A Delibird is running around as if in a panic. As it turns out, a wild Garbodor is menacing it...
It seems a certain apartment building has become haunted. The requester reports hearing strange noises from the rooftop and wants you to go check it out.
Sylveon’s soothing powers should put a stop to fighting! That’s what the requester thinks, anyway. Help her bring the nearby squabbles to a peaceful conclusion.
A researcher who has a fossil restoration device has given you some money to buy a fossil. Pick up either a Jaw Fossil or a Sail Fossil from the Stone Emporium.
The requester wants to open up a Pokémon salon where Furfrou can have their fur trimmed. Help her improve her skill by showing her Scyther a move!
The requester wants to add to her repertoire of Furfrou styles. Help out by showing her Scyther another move!
The requester wants to add even more Furfrou styles to her repertoire. Help out by showing her Scyther yet another move!
Moves that leave a lingering effect on the battlefield are commonly known as traps. Experience their nasty effects for yourself in a Pokémon battle.
The Courier Colis is a huge fan of the Bird Pokémon Pidgeot. He’s particularly fond of the move Fly and wants to share his enthusiasm with you.
Inspired by Canari, the requester is raising a whole bunch of Eelektrik. He says he’ll evolve the strongest one into Eelektross, but will his plan work out?
The move Focus Energy makes a Pokémon’s moves more likely to land as critical hits. Face the requester, who isn’t afraid to use this frightening move!

column3: Better to Detect Than to Protect
column4: Protect and Detect both prevent the user from taking damage, but apparently there is a slight difference between the two.

column3: A Sky Battle, for Old Times’ Sake
column4: Apparently Sky Battles were a bit of a fad in Kalos until just a few years ago. Try having a battle using only Flying-type Pokémon.

column3: Let It Rain, Let It Pour
column4: The requester claims her Pokémon are stronger when it’s raining. Have a battle in the rain so you can witness their might.
The requester says she wants to battle “artistically.” How can a battle be artistic? Face her, and maybe you’ll find out...
What happens when you have a Pokémon hold Leftovers? Have a battle with the hard- working waitress and see for yourself.
The requester’s Galarian Stunfisk has gone missing. Head to Wild Zone 11 and look for a Stunfisk that’s disguised as a Poké Ball.
The requester says she wants to make a perfume using Inkay ink. What kind of aroma will an ink-based perfume have?
Some wild Aron have grown tired of eating the same old scrap metal every day. Maybe you can find some seasoning that will make their meals more appealing?
The requester is a taxi driver who’s new to the job. She wants you to help her get adjusted by being her first fare.
If a Pokémon flinches, it won’t be able to use the move it was trying to unleash. Flynn uses moves that are likely to make opponents flinch, and he wants to face you in battle.

column3: A Fateful Swing of a Metronome
column4: The move Metronome causes a Pokémon to use another random move. It could change the tide of battle...or maybe the Pokémon will just use Splash. Test your fortunes!
A girl says she has some unusual Pokémon on her team no one else around has, and she wants to show them off in battle. What kind of Pokémon could she have?
Some moves deal damage to the opponent while also restoring the user’s HP. Battle the requester to get a glimpse of these moves in action.
Durstin is a maintenance worker who takes his job very seriously, but now he’s so thirsty that nothing seems to be getting done. Maybe a drink will get him back on track?
The requester is having trouble getting a Holovator up and running, as apparently there isn’t enough electric power. Maybe you can give it a zap?
This worker’s on his break, but he says he’ll happily get back to work and have the Holovator up and running right away if you’ll have a Pokémon battle with him.
A Rust Syndicate grunt has chosen one particular Holovator as his favorite, for some reason. Beat him in a battle to get him out of the way.
A Pokémon has made its home in the ground under a Holovator, causing it to malfunction. Unfortunately for the Pokémon, you’ll have to get it to move...
The alpha Watchog is a menace, staring down anyone who dares approach with its glowing red eyes. Defeat it to make the Holovator safe to approach.
Electric-type Pokémon are having a standoff right in front of a Holovator. It’d be great if they could take their shocking disagreement elsewhere.
Wild Beldum have gathered at a Holovator for some reason, making it so nobody can use it even after it was just repaired...

column3: We’ll Just Muscle Our Way Through!
column4: A Holovator seems to have a poor connection to the power grid. The requester claims that giving it a good whack will get it working. Hit it with a Fighting-type physical move.
The requester says he’s going to start a new business with the help of his Camerupt. What exactly is he scheming?
Apparently there is a Furfrou League in Lumiose, complete with Elite Four members all awaiting challengers. Defeat them to become the strongest Furfrou Trainer!
The requester, an SBC member who’s particularly fond of Dragon types, wants to have a battle with you. Use type matchups to your advantage.
Ice-type moves have a chance of freezing the opponent solid. Beware of Glace’s Ice-type Pokémon as you battle her.
Constance battles using only her favorite type of Pokémon: Bug types. We’re at our best when we like what we’re working with, so face her with your favorite Pokémon too!
Unexceptional, ordinary—these are the traits of the Normal type. But ordinary doesn’t mean weak! See for yourself what Normal types can do.
Ghost-type Pokémon are weak to Ghost-type moves. The requester wants to have a battle using only Ghost types to determine who uses them better.
A Rust Syndicate grunt has challenged you to a battle. She seems to be particularly attached to Steel-type Pokémon.
The secret to helping a Honedge feel better is to have it battle a Pupitar...? How is that even supposed to work?
Pokémon Center clerks are experts at healing Pokémon. For this requester, that apparently extends to having her Pokémon use healing moves in battle.
What did the woman mean when she muttered “in 30 seconds”? If you want to find out, you’ll have to face her in battle.
A Trainer is saying he has the strongest Pikachu—and he wants to prove it. Battle him using a single Pikachu against his, and see whose is mightier!
Alolan Raichu apparently look different from Raichu of other regions. Trade your own Raichu for the requester’s Alolan Raichu.
In battle, looks can be deceiving. Battle the requester and her formidable Pokémon.
The requester says she saw a Shiny Mareep in Wild Zone 1! Or at least she thinks she did, but she’s not sure. Help her discover the truth.
A man is wrapped up in Pokémon webbing and dangling from a tree. How did he even end up there? Have your Pokémon use a move to get him down.
A police officer says that he needs a Shuppet to help with his investigations. Do your part in keeping the peace of Lumiose by bringing him one.
The kids in the school courtyard want you to teach them all about Mega Evolution. Let the class begin!
A certain movie director is making a thriller film. He needs a Carvanha for an important scene—lend him one so he can complete his work.
A certain movie director is making a horror film. He needs a Trevenant for an important scene—lend him one so he can complete his work.
A certain movie director is making a kaiju film. He needs a Tyrantrum for an important scene—lend him one so he can complete his work.

column3: Full Course of Battles: One Star
column4: Enjoy a relaxing full course of battles at Restaurant Le Nah. Please note it is considered poor etiquette to heal your Pokémon while the course is being served.

column3: Full Course of Battles: Two Stars
column4: Enjoy a satisfying full course of battles at Restaurant Le Yeah. Please note it is considered poor etiquette to heal your Pokémon while the course is being served.

column3: Full Course of Battles: Three Stars
column4: Enjoy an exquisite full course of battles at Restaurant Le Wow. Please note it is considered poor etiquette to heal your Pokémon while the course is being served.

column3: Full Course of Battles: High Rolling
column4: Have an exciting experience with spectacular Pokémon battles that only Sushi High Roller can offer! Don’t go healing your Pokémon in the middle of things, though!
A designer of color contacts wants to see a Mega Camerupt to get some inspiration. Mega Evolve a Camerupt during your battle with her.
A designer of color contacts wants to see a Mega Sableye to get some inspiration. Mega Evolve a Sableye during your battle with her.
A designer of color contacts wants to see a Mega Medicham to get some inspiration. Mega Evolve a Medicham during your battle with her.
Le Super-Tournoi de Jacinthe is back and even better than before! It will be you against Jacinthe—and ONLY Jacinthe!
A hairstylist wants to expand her hair-color palette by seeing every color of flower that a Flabébé might adopt.
A hairstylist wants you to battle all five of her Floette at once so she can get new ideas for hair colors.
You discovered a large hole in the Rust Syndicate office’s garden. Find the true culprit if you don’t want to take the blame.
It seems that Pumpkaboo come in different varieties that determine their size. The requester wants a Jumbo Variety Pumpkaboo.
Hawlucha gazes over the city, hungering for an intense battle. Satisfy its desire by facing it once more.
The requester’s Klefki apparently misplaced a key. The requester let you know where they went on the day it happened, so see if you can hunt down the key based on that info.
Binacle are swarming the requester’s prized boat, preventing him from taking it out for a ride. Chase away the Binacle for him.
The requester’s Meditite is apparently having trouble focusing. Find the legendary yoga master to see if they can help.
The requester wants you to stop his runaway Whirlipede. Chase after the Whirlipede and battle it to get it to stop.
The requester is an artist working on a painting for a contest. As she was doing some sketches, however, some brambles showed up, ruining the scenery.
A Froslass revealed itself and stared intently at you, as if urging you to follow it.
You’ve been invited to a gathering of people who send messages into space through their Starmie. It would be rude to decline, so join them with a Starmie of your own.
The requester wants a Skarmory feather to craft a chef’s knife. You should be able to find a Skarmory feather in Wild Zone 17.
Spritzee’s fragrance changes depending on what it eats. The requester wants lots of Berries in order to search for new aromas.
A familiar Trainer and her partner Pancham seem to be having trouble with a customer. See if you can help them out.
Find all the Spewpa hiding throughout the museum. Apparently there are 12 in total.
The requester wants you to help her Numel, which has been frozen solid. Hit it with a high-powered Fire-type attack to thaw it out!
Two children are arguing over which fossil to buy with their pocket money. The girl wants to buy a Sail Fossil, but her brother seems intent on getting a Jaw Fossil.
Apparently there is a Mawile that can never be caught, no matter what kind of Poké Ball you use or how many you throw at it.
The requester is looking for a place to share with his Heliolisk. Help him find the perfect spot based on his exacting conditions.
The requester says his younger sister has gone missing after following a wild Litwick. Just as you were about to hear his full story, you noticed a Litwick staring at you...
The requester wants to make a business out of having his Clauncher wash away sludge around Lumiose using Water Gun. Clauncher, however, seems unenthusiastic.
A wild Chespin has decided to pick a fight with a taxi cab. The driver can’t move the cab with Chespin in the way—see if you can help her out.
You came across a wild Fennekin that seems lethargic and listless. It apparently refuses to eat food, and even taking it to a Pokémon Center did nothing. What else can you do?
A Froakie currently reigns as the fastest to complete a scaffolding course. Try to beat its time to show it how fast humans can be.
Josée of the Fist of Justice has requested that you battle her. She seems to have something on her mind—an all-out battle might help clear her head.

column3: Up, Up, and Away After Emolga!
column4: A wild Emolga is apparently causing trouble by stealing things from people. Chase after it using Roto-Glide and retrieve the requester’s Berries.
The requester wants to put four Bergmite on the back of a giant Avalugg for some photos. You’ll need an extra-large Avalugg for that.
The requester wants you to help him find a Gengar that has gone missing. Perhaps Gwynn can help you, since she is very knowledgeable about Ghost-type Pokémon.
Mable called and asked you to come to the Pokémon Research Lab. What is she up to now?
After picking up on some sort of psychic energy from one of your Mega Stones, Mimi got up and headed out. Where could Mimi be off to?
The systems at the old Lysandre Labs have reactivated, unleashing a dangerous Pokémon that was once a research subject. This is an emergency—catch Mewtwo!
The requester has come up with a battle plan in which he gives his Pokémon Berries to hold. He seems very confident, but do his skills measure up?
